newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges quoted steady to up on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted steady to higher on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. Eight barges traded on Southbound Barge Freight Options versus no trade on Thursday, exchange sources said.

- Eight barges, two each week of October, 1997, call options, Mid-Mississippi, strike price at 260 percent net 10 days, traded at 7-1/2 percent of tariff, with Peavey selling to Consolidated Grain and Barge, sources said.
- Two barges, next week, Lower Ohio River, bid 205 percent of tariff, offer 215 percent, up five percentage points.
- Two barges, next week, Mid-Mississippi, no bid, offer 235 percent, unchanged from Thursday.
- Four barges, one each week November, Illinois River, bid 175 percent, offer 185 percent, unchanged.
- Five barges, one each week December, Lower Ohio River, no bid, offer 135 percent.
